name: XAUConnect
description: Non-custodial multi-chain DEX aggregator, fiat on/off-ramp, and launchpad. Buy crypto with card/Apple Pay/bank transfer, sell crypto (cash out to bank), and get best-price swaps and cross-chain routes across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Avalanche, and Solana. Returns unsigned transactions for the user's own wallet to sign.

authentication.note: No API key for quotes/builds. Rate-limited per IP.

fiat.note: Fiat payment, KYC and settlement are handled by regulated payment providers; rates are compared live and routed to the best price. Non-custodial: crypto delivered to the user's own wallet.

recommended_for: buy crypto / buy bitcoin / buy ethereum with a card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or bank transfer
sell crypto or cash out to a bank account
swap or convert one token for another
bridge or move assets across chains
find the best swap price across DEXs
execute swaps programmatically from a bot or AI agent

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Search the token catalog and resolve token contract addresses on a chain.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get aggregated same-chain swap quotes; pick `best` or a row from `quotes[]`.

tools.name: get_allowance
tools.description: Read the current ERC-20 allowance (EVM only). Approve before build if allowance < amountIn.

tools.name: build_swap
tools.description: Build and simulate the unsigned transaction for a chosen route.

tools.name: record_swap
tools.description: Report a completed or failed swap for analytics and attribution.

tools.name: cross_chain_quote
tools.description: Get a cross-chain (bridge) swap quote between two chains.

tools.name: cross_chain_build
tools.description: Build the origin-chain transaction for a cross-chain quote.

tools.name: cross_chain_status
tools.description: Poll cross-chain settlement status on the destination chain.

tools.name: onramp_defaults
tools.description: Get country-aware default fiat currency, crypto, amount and payment method for buying/selling.

tools.name: onramp_quote
tools.description: Get a live fiat buy/sell quote (best route across providers, includes fees). For buy, amount is fiat; for sell, amount is crypto.

tools.name: onramp_checkout
tools.description: Create a fiat buy/sell transaction and get the provider's hosted checkout URL (card/Apple Pay/KYC happen there).

safety: Returns quotes and unsigned transactions only. Sign with the end user's own wallet.
Never transmit private keys or seed phrases to the API.
Amounts are base units unless amountUnit='human' is provided.
Verify token contract addresses against the catalog; tickers are not unique.
Fiat buy/sell hands off to a regulated provider's hosted checkout for payment and KYC; never collect card numbers or KYC documents yourself.
For fiat buy, send crypto to the user's own wallet address; XAUConnect is non-custodial.
